semiconductor_relevance: High — WuHu LDZX Semiconductor Co., Ltd. specializes in semiconductor packaging equipment, which is critical for the manufacturing and assembly of semiconductor devices.
summary: WuHu LDZX Semiconductor Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced semiconductor packaging equipment, including die bonding, sorting, inspection, and testing systems. Their products are widely utilized in the production of electronic components and integrated circuits, serving over 200 manufacturers across key economic zones in China.
capabilities: Ultrasonic hot-press fully automatic flip-chip die bonders
Fully automatic IC sorting and stacking machines

regional_presence.China: The company has a manufacturing base located in Guilin and serves customers in major economic zones such as the Pearl River Delta and Yangtze River Delta.
